preconditions.description: The number of breakfasts, dinners, and suppers must be non-negative.
The total number of meals must be at least one.

postconditions.description: The minimum number of missed meals must be non-negative.
The minimum number of missed meals cannot exceed the total number of meals.

postconditions.expression: return_value == b + d + s - max(b, d, s)
postconditions.description: The minimum number of missed meals is the total number of meals minus the maximum number of meals of any single type.
